product: ELM Surfaces Formed Hexagon Tile in Sand (Matte / Raw / Chiseled faces)

atlas.face_index_order: index = row*8 + column + 1; flat-top, odd columns shifted down half a row; face centre x = (column+0.5)*8.7685 in, y = (row+0.5)*10.125 in (+5.0625 in odd columns)

face_transform_convention: rotation_deg is counter-clockwise (y up). chiseled: tile rotation of the groove pattern, canonical tile = vertical grooves with the steep flank facing -x (grooves run at 90+rotation deg). matte: rotation of the low band (tone/cloudiness); both bands listed. raw: 0 = the render's texture axis kept; the face is a quilt, per-patch transforms listed (I = identity, R180 = rotated 180, M30/M120 = mirrored about the 30/120 deg axis, +-8 = extra jitter deg). mirrored = true when any mirrored source content is used in the face.

wrap_seam_steps.method: mean |step| across the wrap seam vs interior boundaries at the same lattice phase (x = k*W/8, y = k*H/7); pass if seam <= 1.15 x the largest matched interior step

relief.height_scale: Bump16 value v -> height = v/65535 * 2.60 mm; 0 = joint floor

chiseled_geometry.profile: asymmetric: fundamental + 2nd harmonic (0.30, +100 deg rel. phase)
